remarks: Welcome to your new home in the heart of the charming Glenbrook neighborhood of Stamford, CT! This beautifully renovated 2-bedroom apartment offers a perfect blend of modern amenities and classic elegance, making it an ideal choice for those seeking comfort and convenience.  Step into a fresh and modern living space with brand-new finishes and fixtures designed to provide a comfortable and stylish setting for your everyday life.   Enjoy the generous layout of this apartment, featuring two spacious bedrooms with ample closet space and plenty of natural light throughout. Nestled in the desirable Glenbrook neighborhood, you'll be within walking distance of local shops, restaurants, and public transportation. Plus, easy access to major highways makes commuting a breeze.  The updated kitchen boasts sleek countertops, new appliances, and plenty of cabinet space, perfect for both everyday cooking and entertaining. Enjoy the convenience of on-site laundry facilities, off-street parking, and additional storage options.  **Lease Terms:**  - **Credit Requirement:** A credit score of 680+ is required to qualify for this apartment.  - **Lease Duration:** A yearly lease is required  Don't miss out on this opportunity to live in a beautifully renovated apartment in one of Stamford's most sought-after neighborhoods. Schedule a viewing and make this charming apartment your new home!
